description: Five short functional checks; not a general model-quality or capacity benchmark. Each case starts with cleared state on both devices.

cases.prompt: Calculate 17 times 23. Respond only with the integer.
Mira has 4 red marbles and 7 blue marbles. She gives away 2 blue marbles. How many marbles does she have left? Respond only with the integer.
Return a JSON object with exactly two fields: status set to the string ok, and count set to the integer 3. Return only JSON, with no explanation or markdown.
Calculate 17 times 23. Respond only with the integer.
In one short sentence, explain why the sky appears blue.
